overview: Tactical Droid is a tactical droid built by Baktoid Combat Automata, documented across Clone Wars. Calculated Separatist commanders with elongated heads and cold strategic subroutines that coordinated fleet and ground offensives until Republic capture became a intelligence goldmine.
history:

T-series tactical droids coordinated CIS armies with calculated cruelty and frequent overconfidence. Engineering analysis of Tactical Droid highlights why tactical droid designs succeed: modular parts, clear firmware roles, and production lines scaled to wartime demand. Technicians praise Tactical Droid's modular tactical droid subsystems: field-replaceable limbs, redundant processors, and firmware packages that slicers and mechanics exploit in scrap yards centuries after initial rollout. Technicians praise Baktoid Combat Automata documentation; slicers praise its predictable security flaws—both keep Tactical Droid relevant in scrap yards centuries later.
